title: quercus sessiliflora var. lanuginosa
intro: Quercus sessiliflora var. lanuginosa, commonly known as the hairy chestnut oak, is a deciduous tree species within the Fagaceae family. The hairy chestnut oak is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce the risk of chronic diseases like cardiovascular disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Quercus sessiliflora var. lanuginosa include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of the hairy chestnut oak include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
